messages:
leo_csm: Heads up — SkillBridge cohort wants a quick drop-in next week for onboarding. Can we run a 45m slot to cover dedicated account config + migration checklist?

Aisha (aisha_csm): I'm available Tue/Wed 9-11am PT. Will need a timezone-friendly option for APAC attendees.

priya_enablement: Agenda proposal: 1) onboarding checklist walkthrough (10m) 2) network & VPC tips (10m) 3) demo: config + failover (15m) 4) Q&A + next steps (10m). Also want to capture a short prework survey.

leo_csm: Love it. Can you share a survey link? Also want to add 'how to validate cost / billing' as item 5 (5m).

priya_enablement: Survey: https://forms.gle/skillbridge-prework (brief). Added billing validation to agenda — will tighten timings.

tom_sched-bot: Poll created: https://cal.com/skillbridge/dropin — options: Tue 16 Aug 2026 16:00 PT / Wed 17 Aug 8:00 PT / Thu 18 Aug 00:00 PT (for APAC). Comment with ✓ for preferred slot.

Aisha (aisha_csm): ✓ Wed 17 Aug 8:00 PT works for me.

leo_csm: ✓ Wed too. I'll prep the billing examples.

ops-bot: Calendar invite sent to skillbridge@example.com and attendees (meeting id: 872-9936). Agenda attached in calendar description.

priya_enablement: Quick ask — can eng send snippet of recommended RBAC roles + cli command for service account provisioning so I can paste into slide?

sam_eng: @priya_enablement dropping this in thread: `redwoodctl iam create --role=serving-reader --sa=skillbridge-bot` — we'll paste into slides.

leo_csm: OK locking Wed 17 Aug 8:00 PT. Thanks all :thumbsup:

Aisha (aisha_csm): Also capturing feedback — will send follow-up survey after the session.
